import glob
import pandas as pd

files = glob.glob('**/budget.xlsx', recursive=True)
print("Found files:", files)
if not files:
    raise SystemExit("budget.xlsx not found")

import glob
import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

files = glob.glob('**/budget.xlsx', recursive=True)
print("Found files:", files)
if not files:
    raise SystemExit("budget.xlsx not found")

path = files[0]
NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("Zip entries:", z.namelist())
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rel_map = {r.get('Id'): r.get('Target') for r in rels}
    sheet_names = [(s.get('name'), s.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')) for s in wb.find('m:sheets', NS)]
    print("Sheets:", sheet_names)
    for name, rid in sheet_names:
        target = rel_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target
        print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} ({target}) ---")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        shared_strings = []
        if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
            sst = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
            for si in sst.findall('m:si', NS):
                shared_strings.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))
        for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                val = v.text if v is not None else None
                t = c.get('t')
                if t == 's' and val is not None:
                    val = shared_strings[int(val)]
                if val is not None:
                    print(f"{ref}: {val!r}")
